about: Sainte-Sophie is a municipality in the Laurentians foothills of Quebec, north of Montreal toward Saint-Jérôme and the Highway 15 corridor. Suburban growth, remaining countryside, and village services characterize a fast-changing North Shore community at the edge of the metro area. About 18,000 people live in Sainte-Sophie.
seoSummary: Laurentians-foothill municipality north of Montreal—growing North Shore community toward Saint-Jérôme, not a big city.
